Callout.Name: Illegal Street Vendor
Callout.Advisory: One male, stall set up, no violence.

Script.Line: I have a licence. It is at home in a drawer.
I am not blocking anybody. There is a path behind me.
Everybody in this market is doing the same thing.

Lines.Approach: Pavement blocked, no licence, and he has been told twice already.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
